title: Question
description: One entry of knowledge-eval/data/questions_<subject>_6up.json. Options are plain strings and their label is positional (A = index 0), so the file needs no {label, text} wrapper and no translation before validation. 判断题 is 选择题 with two options; 简答题 does not exist (the TV keypad has no letters).

diagnostic_node_id.description: A node_id, never the auto-increment id. Must point at a diagnostic node, never at a chapter.

options.description: Choice only, in display order. Label of options[i] is 'A' + i, which is what correct_answer names.

correct_answer.description: Choice: a label (A/B/C/D) that indexes into options. Fill: the canonical answer string, equal to accepted[0].

accepted.description: Fill only: other strings that count as the same answer. Numeric comparison is exact, so list 7/2 and 3.5 both when both are natural.
